The name Kevyn carries the meaning “Born of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Kevyn usually hope their child will grow to embody born of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
